name: AuraLAN
tagline: A local-first LAN inventory and network monitoring console
description: AuraLAN is a self-hosted, local-first network console for Linux and Raspberry Pi. It combines local network evidence into a human-readable device inventory with Activity Center history, Network Baseline, Identity Intelligence, Service Exposure snapshots, reachability checks and Home Assistant integration. AuraLAN requires no cloud account and includes no telemetry or cloud fingerprinting.

features.title: Network Device Inventory
features.description: Build a human-readable inventory from local LAN evidence

features.title: Activity Center
features.description: Track meaningful network changes in a local timeline

features.title: Network Baseline
features.description: Compare the current network with an operator-defined reference point

features.title: Identity Intelligence
features.description: Explain which local evidence supports device identities

features.title: Service Exposure
features.description: Inspect a bounded set of common TCP ports and retain change history

features.title: Home Assistant Integration
features.description: Expose aggregate REST data and optional reliable webhooks

features.title: Local-first Operation
features.description: Run without accounts, telemetry, cloud lookups or remote runtime assets
